ground_truth.note: search «телефон» (total 2107, page 1, 8 items per page): the fixture for the zone path that replaced the missing collections. Each productSnippet zone carries its own analytics payload in data-zone-data; the three kept rows, decoded straight out of this snapshot, are: Realme Note 60х 4/128GB Зеленый — osku 4315891968, marketSku 103796664836, base price 12450 (struck through), additionalPrices withDiscount 11329 (everyday, what anyone pays), yaBank 11102 (green Yandex Plus); Android 15 12/512ГБ — osku 6113276550, marketSku 6113276550, base 16569, withDiscount 6195, yaBank 6071; Samsung Galaxy A17 6/128GB Голубой — osku 4680656365, marketSku 4696420378, base 20980, withDiscount 19092, yaBank 18710. Independent cross-check inside the same snapshot: the schema.org ItemList carries exactly the yaBank figures (11102 / 6071 / 18710) as offers.price — it is the Plus-only view of the very same offers, and it is why quoting offers.price as price_rub would misstate the everyday cost by 25-30 percent. The everyday figures are NOT present as visible text anywhere in the snippet DOM (the SERP prints only the green Plus amount); they exist only as additionalPrices[withDiscount], verified live 2026-09-11 against the product card's prices.price row for the same offers (see search_kettle.provenance.json for that cross-check). Seller comes from the payload's shop signal: ОНЛАЙНТРЕЙД.РУ on rows 0 and 2, absent on row 1 (the Android row ships no shop signal) — an absent seller must read as empty, never as a guess. brand is unresolvable on this path: the payload ships only vendorId.
